title: Degree-t Nilpotency Cutoff of Overlapping CNOT Carries Modulo 2^t and Hypergraph Phase Repair
claims: In the Z_{2^t} expansion of x_r = u_1 (+) ... (+) u_m = sum_{k=1}^m (-2)^{k-1} sum_{|J|=k} prod_{j in J} u_j, all multilinear carry terms of degree k >= t + 1 vanish identically modulo 2^t.
At t=2 (mod 4), pairwise CZ^{p_r} gates conditioned on LSB parity p_r = <A_{.,r}, s> mod 2 restore 100% product state fidelity for any m >= 2 overlapping trees.
At t=3 (mod 8), pairwise controlled-S gates plus 3-body CCZ^{p_r} gates restore 100% product state fidelity for any m >= 3 overlapping trees.
favorable_controls: mod 4 m=2 and m=3 overlapping trees (CZ repair F=1.0)
mod 8 m=3 and m=4 overlapping trees (controlled-S + CCZ repair F=1.0 vs 9/16 without CCZ)
